record.body:
## Problem

The phase opens as a modal over the effort page, with its own tabs. It sits outside the drill-down that `area-levels` adds, so the breadcrumb ends at the effort. The effort page also selects a phase to filter its task table, and a second press opens the modal, which is a two-step click.

## Approach

Build on `area-levels`. The phase becomes the fourth level, a routed page in the main pane. Settled by the user. Decisions: `phase-page-main-pane`, `leaf-views-stay-modals`, `effort-tasks-move-to-phase`.

- `#/phase/<effort>/<phase>[/tab/<tab>]` renders a page: breadcrumb `Product › Area › Effort › Phase`, header with title and state, chips, next action, requirement buttons, tabs, task graph, status tabs, task list, evidence board and sections.
- The effort page lists phases as rows with progress bars. A row opens the phase page. The effort page drops its task table and status tabs.
- The left rail on the phase page lists the phases of the effort, marks the current one and folds older done phases.
- The task, requirement, needs, backlog and record views stay modals over the phase page. Their write buttons do not move.
- Esc on the phase page opens the effort page. Existing `#/phase/...` deep links keep working.

Rejected: a full-screen dialog, pages for the leaf views, and keeping the task table on the effort page.

## Exit criteria

- R1 to R30 of the specification pass. Verified by the vitest tests in `dashboard/frontend/src` and the Playwright test.
- The existing overlay tests for the leaf views pass unchanged.
- `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass. `basedpyright`, `ruff` and `canon validate` pass.
- Full CI passes on a pushed branch. Verified by a CI run observation.

## Proof

kind: demo. A human opens an effort, clicks a phase row, and sees the phase page with the four-part breadcrumb. They open a task, then close it and land back on the phase page.
